chunks.title: Instruments
chunks.text: Status quo (voluntary commitments): No new obligation. Existing consumer and product law only, with the regulator's present capacity. Every other policy is measured against this path, pair by pair. Liability with a safe harbour: Strict liability, but a firm that meets the evaluation and safety spend standard is shielded from most of it. Compliance becomes the cheaper choice. Mandatory third party evaluation: Independent pre deployment evaluation above a threshold, with a short approval delay. Catches a share of unsafe releases before they ship. Strict liability: Firms pay for the harm their systems cause, insured by mandate. No ex ante obligation: the price of an incident does the work, and the firms choose their own safety spend.

Firm risk aversion: 0.6 multiple; weight on the variance of expected liability in the firm's choice; bounds 0.0 to 2.0.
Firm optimism: 0.7 multiple; the share of its true incident rate a firm believes when it plans; bounds 0.3 to 1.0.
Audit rate: 0.5 a month at full capacity; probability a firm in scope is audited in a month at capacity 1; bounds 0.05 to 1.0.
Insurance loading: 0.25 share; premium above expected liability charged by insurers under a mandate; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.
Safe harbour shield: 0.7 share; share of liability a compliant firm avoids under a safe harbour; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.
Moratorium research slowdown: 0.5 share; share of capability growth lost by a firm in scope while a moratorium holds; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.
Enforcement response: 0.25 a month; speed at which enforcement intensity follows public pressure; bounds 0.05 to 1.0.
Trust recovery: 0.05 a month; monthly recovery of public trust towards 1; bounds 0.01 to 0.2.
Trust harm sensitivity: 0.04 per log $bn; fall in trust per unit of log monetised harm in a month; bounds 0.0 to 0.3.
News memory: 0.75 a month; persistence of the news pressure index; bounds 0.3 to 0.95.
News reporting boost: 0.35 share; extra salience of incidents when reporting is mandatory; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.
Market vol: 0.045 a month; volatility of the common market factor; bounds 0.01 to 0.12.
Sentiment persistence: 0.85 a month; persistence of the price's non fundamental component; bounds 0.5 to 0.98.
News price impact: 0.06 per unit of pressure; price impact of a unit of news pressure on an exposed firm; bounds 0.0 to 0.3.
Incident jump: 0.5 multiple; own incident price jump per log unit of harm relative to revenue; bounds 0.0 to 2.0.
contagion: 0.3 share; share of an own incident jump felt by the rest of the sector; bounds 0.0 to 1.0.

Chip demand coupling: 0.6 elasticity; chip and cloud revenue growth per unit of model developers' capability growth; bounds 0.0 to 1.5.
